description: This source file implements utility functions for handling file paths and URLs, including conversion between file paths and file URLs, and generating safe filenames, primarily used within the Chromium project.

methods.name: FilePathToFileURL
methods.description: Converts a file path to a file URL, handling encoding and platform-specific path formats.

methods.name: FileURLToFilePath
methods.description: Converts a file URL to a file path, decoding percent-encodings and handling platform-specific path formats.

methods.name: GenerateSafeFileName
methods.description: Ensures the filename has a safe extension based on MIME type and modifies it if necessary to avoid reserved names.

methods.name: IsReservedNameOnWindows
methods.description: Checks if a filename is a reserved name on Windows, including device names and special filenames.
